messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 12):
"""
Specifically indicate that if the policyholder avails services in hospitals / healthcare service providers other than the (a) above reimbursement of claim will have to be filed with the Insurer c. Procedures to be followed by the policyholder for claim settlement under cashless facility and reimbursement of claims d. Turn Around Time for policy servicing, approvals of cashless as well as reimbursement claim settlement e. List of products on offer and products withdrawn (6) Training: Provide periodical training to Intermediaries, distribution channels and employees of the Insurers on their products (existing and new), TATs in policy servicing, changes in the regulations etc. (7) Put in place end to end technology solutions so as to ensure an effective, efficient and a seamless onboarding of policyholders, renewal of policy, policy servicing, grievance redressal and claim settlement process. II.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What type of training must insurers provide to intermediaries and employees regarding their health insurance products?","answer":"Insurers must provide periodical training to intermediaries, distribution channels, and employees on their products, including existing and new offerings, turnaround times for policy servicing, and regulatory changes.","facts":["Provide periodical training to Intermediaries, distribution channels and employees of the Insurers on their products (existing and new)","TATs in policy servicing, changes in the regulations etc."]},{"question":"What technology solutions are insurers required to implement to ensure efficient policy management and claim settlement?","answer":"Insurers must put in place end-to-end technology solutions that enable seamless onboarding of policyholders, renewal, policy servicing, grievance redressal, and claim settlement processes.","facts":["Put in place end to end technology solutions so as to ensure an effective, efficient and a seamless onboarding of policyholders, renewal of policy, policy servicing, grievance redressal and claim settlement process."]}]}
